chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham al-Mu'addib (may God have mercy upon him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha'i narrated to me from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from his father, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them all). He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

When the Day of Resurrection comes, you will be brought — O Ali — on a she-camel of light. Upon your head will be a crown with four pillars, and upon each pillar will be three inscriptions: 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, Ali is the Friend of Allah.' You will be given the keys to Paradise.

Then a seat known as the 'Seat of Honour' will be placed for you, and you will sit upon it. Then the former and latter peoples will be gathered before you on one plain. You will direct your Shi'a to Paradise and your enemies to the Fire, for you are the Divider of Paradise and the Divider of the Fire. He who aligns with you is triumphant, and he who opposes you has lost. On that Day, you will be the trustee of God and the clear Proof of God.

key_terms.أمين الله: Trustee of God — a divine title denoting Ali's role as custodian of God's covenant
key_terms.حجة الله الواضحة: The clear Proof of God — Ali as the manifest divine argument on earth and in the afterlife
key_terms.قسيم الجنة والنار: Divider of Paradise and Fire — Ali's unique eschatological role as the arbiter of souls
key_terms.كرسي الكرامة: Seat of Honour — the throne from which Ali will preside over judgment
key_terms.ناقة من نور: A she-camel of light — an otherworldly mount symbolizing Ali's elevated spiritual station

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about Imam Ali's role on the Day of Resurrection in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a prophetic address from the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) to Imam Ali (AS), describing his exalted eschatological station on the Day of Resurrection. The Prophet declares that Ali will appear mounted on a she-camel of light, crowned with a crown bearing the three foundational declarations of Shia faith, and will serve as the arbiter determining who enters Paradise and who goes to the Fire. This narration is transmitted through a notable chain including Abu Hamza al-Thumali, the trusted companion of multiple Imams, reflecting the Shia theological doctrine of Ali's divinely-granted authority (wilayah) extending even into the afterlife.
word_analysis: may God have mercy upon him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Ahmad b. Hisham al-Mu’addab (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ja`far al-Asadi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. `Imran al-Nakha`i narrated to me from his uncle al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali from `Ali b. Abi Hamza from his father from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

On the Day of Resurrection, you will come – O `Ali – on a she-camel of light. A crown with four pillars will be upon your head, and on each pillar, three lines will be written: “There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, `Ali is the Friend of Allah (la ilaha illallah, muhammadan rasul Allah, `Aliyyun wali Allah).” You will be given the keys to Paradise.

Then, a seat known as the “Seat of Honour” will be placed for you, and you will sit on it. Then, the former and the latter peoples will be gathered for you on one plane. Then, you will command your Shi`a to go to Paradise and your enemies to the Fire, for you are the Divider of Paradise, and you are the Divider of the Fire. He who aligns with you is triumphant, and he who opposes you has lost. On that Day, you will be the trustee of Allah and the clear Proof of Allah.
